formDerivation: e_a wedge T^a has Weyl weight 2; the four-dimensional Hodge star on a three-form has weight -2, so S = star(e_a wedge T^a) has weight 0
conformalVerdict: the dimension-four density sqrt(g) S_mu J_5^mu is Weyl invariant and is not forbidden by conformal enlargement
topologicalVerdict: the operator is a local interaction rather than a closed characteristic density, so topology does not quantize its coefficient
